job.title: Seeking a Senior Oracle Cloud Payroll Techno- Functional ...

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Seeking a Senior Oracle Cloud Payroll Techno- Functional ...
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in your techno-functional consulting opportunity, bringing over 5 years of hands-on experience building and supporting enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. As an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer, I specialize in bridging complex business requirements with robust backend implementations.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Extensively worked in a techno-functional capacity, analysing complex integration requirements with business and technical stakeholders, writing user stories, and translating them into scalable solutions.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integrations
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized data pipelines and OCC REST APIs between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems, ensuring seamless data flow and high system availability.

bullets.label: Platform Customization
bullets.text: Developed and maintained core backend modules, Promotions Engine, Hotfolders, FlexibleSearch queries, Cronjobs, and Order Management systems using Java and Spring.

bullets.label: Agile Stakeholder Collaboration
bullets.text: Collaborated closely with international business teams, product owners, and technical experts across agile workflows to deliver reliable e-commerce solutions and support production environments.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am available to start from 16.12.2026 following my notice period. I look forward to discussing how my techno-functional expertise aligns with your needs.

tailoring.why_company: I want to bring my 5+ years of enterprise SAP Commerce and techno-functional experience to your team, combining deep Java and API integration skills with structured business analysis to deliver scalable, high-performance platforms.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce expertise, strong techno-functional consulting skills, and robust Java/API integration capabilities to drive your enterprise projects.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of enterprise SAP Commerce experience and a strong techno-functional background in Java, Spring, and API integrations, I am very interested in your opening. I'd love to connect and discuss how I can contribute.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior Techno-Functional Consultant — Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for your open techno-functional position. With over 5 years of professional experience delivering enterprise SAP Commerce solutions, Java backends, and complex system integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical depth and strong stakeholder collaboration skills. I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and can start on 16.12.2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
